                a[i] = a[n - 1 - i];

                s[i] = s[n - 1 - i];
                s[n - 1 - i] = tempC;
            }

        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            edges.add(new Edge(src, i, 1, 0));
            edges.add(new Edge(n - 1 - i, sink, 1, 0));
            for (int j = 0; j < n / 2; j++) {
                if (s[i] != s[n - 1 - j]) {
                    edges.add(new Edge(i, n - 1 - j, 1, i == j ? 0 : a[i]));
                }
            }
        }

        long totalSum = 0;
        for (int val : a) totalSum += val;

            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.flow = 0;
        }

            rev.complement = e;

            g[e.from][idx[e.from]++] = e;
        }

        int n = g.length;
        long minCost = 0;
        int[] potential = new int[n];
        int[] dist = new int[n];
        Edge[] parent = new Edge[n];

        while (totalFlow > 0) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
            dist[s] = 0;

                            dist[e.to] = nd;
                            parent[e.to] = e;
                            pq.offer(new int[]{e.to, nd});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent[t] == null) break;
            int flow = totalFlow;

                flow = Math.min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow);

            long cost = 0;

                e.flow += flow;
                e.complement.flow -= flow;
                cost += (long) e.cost * flow;
            }
            minCost += cost;
            totalFlow -= flow;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

                }
            }
        }
        return minCost;
